evidence.detail: Remove old chart image generation in favor of Chart.js — ripped out decksite/charts/chart.py and all image-based rendering
Chart now uses <canvas class='chart' data-type=... data-labels=... data-series=... data-options=...>, i.e. Chart.js
Person page Colors Played chart uses same Canvas/Chart.js pattern
history_chart() returns JSON dict with type/labels/series/options for Chart.js rendering, no server-side image generation

triage.notes: The decksite/charts/ directory still exists but only contains __init__.py; the old chart.py is gone.
triage.proposed_comment: This was fixed in commit 2450e6b3 (May 2024), which removed all server-side image chart generation (`decksite/charts/chart.py`) and migrated every chart to Chart.js rendered via `<canvas>` elements in the browser. The person-page Colors Played chart the issue comments reference was the model for this migration.
